_comment: Regression test for https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/issues/11092 - `a.js` re-exports `lib.js`, so the `export * from 'ext'` record in `lib.js` is entry-level for `a`. But `lib.js` lands in a common chunk that `b.js` also loads, and only the `a` chunk renders `export * from 'ext'`. The common chunk must still import `ext`.
